title: Maintain managed task-sync custody with write-ahead artifact reservations
outcome: Extend the existing retention owner with exact write-ahead selected artifact custody and canonical delta dispatch, so ordinary managed operations avoid historical filesystem enumeration.
acceptance: Managed artifact preparation, commit retention, import planning and publication use the existing custody reservation and exact durable write-ahead request before filesystem effects; partial or uncertain effects remain recoverable without deletion or reminting.

Managed continuity is activated only after a complete admitted cold checkpoint and all supported writers participate; ordinary reads validate selected records and references without enumerating disconnected historical artifacts.

Additive delta/checkpoint dispatch stays in the existing canonical ledger/reducer with atomic projection upkeep; incoming source, prepared export, confirmed publication and local destination bases remain distinct.
Behavioural tests prove exact retry, interrupted writer recovery, refusal on stale/divergent custody and work independent of unrelated history; bootstrap/named audit retains exhaustive validation.
Document managed-writer continuity and explicit cold-audit boundaries; no independent landing, ordinary sync wiring before atomic graph admission, or separate projection cutover.
